attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post. He cites Zitron and Sutskever nearby, but this sentence is his.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps 'to a first approximation' and the full list of companies. That phrase limits how precise the claim is; it does not express probability, so the claim is still a scorable observation.

contract.note: The plain reading is ordinary: a shared, central strategy of building larger frontier LLMs toward AGI. It allows for approximation and does not treat side research as a contradiction. The 2025 window and the three-company threshold are evaluator choices, but reasonable ones, and the result would be the same without them.

evidence.note: OpenAI disclosure, Feb 2025: GPT-4.5 is its largest model. This supports enlargement for one lab only, and does not on its own show AGI intent.
Meta disclosure, Apr 2025: Behemoth has about 2T total and 288B active parameters. This supports enlargement at Meta but does not show AGI intent.
Google, Nov 2025: Gemini 3 presented as a step toward AGI. This shows AGI intent only; no size comparison is given.
Qwen, Apr 2025: links Qwen3 to AGI and names larger model size as a future aim. This covers one Chinese company only.
xAI, Jul 2025: describes scaled-up RL and tool use. That is compute and method, not model size, so it neither confirms nor disproves the claim.
Anthropic, Nov 2025: describes token efficiency, a different measure from model size. It says nothing about size or AGI.
DeepSeek, Sep 2025: an attention-efficiency change on the same base model. This does not show that enlargement stopped, so it is not a material exception.
Baidu, Jun 2025: ERNIE 4.5 family with up to 424B parameters. There is no size history and no AGI link.

reviews.rationale: The packet shows enlargement at OpenAI and Meta, and AGI intent at Google and Qwen. It does not show both parts for every named lab: there is no size history for Google, Anthropic or xAI, and no full record for three Chinese companies. The efficiency and RL items (e5, e7) do not show any lab abandoning larger models. Neither the support condition nor the contradiction condition is met.
